content: MK reports that in his second apology Ṣāʾin al-Dīn describes a conversation in Herat with another Sufi master, 'almost certainly' Qāsim-i Anvār, whose disciples were antinomian; this time he persuaded the master to restrain them from libertinism and messianic tendencies; he claims to have tried the same with many other masters.
refers_to_primary: MK identifying the second apology's Herat interlocutor
